name: Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5
time_window_text: In the past month, have you...
sensitive_content_warning: The next few questions ask about stressful experiences.

items.text: Had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to?
Tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)?
Been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled?
Felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings?
Felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused?

band_descriptions.negative_screen: Your responses suggest a negative screen for post-traumatic stress symptoms over the past month. Most people experience occasional stress responses, and your responses fall within the typical range.
band_descriptions.positive_screen: Your responses indicate a positive screen for post-traumatic stress symptoms over the past month. This is worth paying attention to, and exploring supportive professional resources could be highly beneficial.
